title: Strategy refinement + pattern hardening for sutra_explore
description:
## Parent

sutra/169 — PRD: sutra_explore

## What to build

Complete the strategy selector and pattern expansion to their full PRD spec.

**Strategy refinement:**
1. Full 5-rule selector: top score > 2× second → read_top_n n=1; top 2-3 within 2× → read_top_n n=2-3; <3 total → read_all; 10+ diffuse hits → narrow_query; 80%+ same component → explore_component.
2. narrow_query rationale includes suggested refinement patterns based on component clustering of the diffuse hits.
3. Summary section: total_items, direct_matches, fan_out_items, components_touched, total_estimated_tokens.

**Pattern hardening:**
4. CamelCase pattern variants (e.g. "import parsing" → `ImportPars`).
5. Qualified-name detection: query containing `::` falls through to sutra_find behavior, result wrapped in same response shape with read_top_n n=1 strategy.

**Tests:**
6. Strategy selector unit tests covering all 5 rules with mock result sets.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All 5 strategy rules produce correct action + rationale
- [ ] narrow_query suggests refinements based on component clustering
- [ ] Summary section present with all fields
- [ ] CamelCase pattern variants generated
- [ ] Query with `::` detected and handled via sutra_find fallthrough
- [ ] Strategy selector unit tests cover all 5 rules

## Blocked by

- sutra/173

execution_record: All 6 acceptance criteria landed in one commit. Key decisions: (1) select_strategy takes scores slice + component counts instead of bare hit counts — enables score-distribution and component-concentration rules; (2) 0.4 threshold for weak top score in narrow_query rule — tunable without contract change; (3) CamelCase truncation takes first 4 chars of last word (matching PRD example ImportPars); (4) :: fallthrough short-circuits handle() entirely, wrapping sutra_find results in explore response shape. No plan deviation — SymbolRow has all-public fields, so tests construct mock data directly without needing an intermediate struct.
